road_visit_writes.limits: SQLite trigger counts for the interval table, not total database writes or measured battery/WAL bytes. Point resolution and road metadata updates remain. Existing departure/merge/legacy regression cases are retained.

friend_accept_retries.before: The accepted row's xmin changes after the repeated accepts; the new regression fails.
friend_accept_retries.after: xmin, requester, creation timestamp and consent remain identical; every retry succeeds.
friend_accept_retries.limits: Avoids unchanged friendship tuple versions. Does not skip authenticated request reservations, user locks, attestation or provider credits.

municipal_cache.cache_lifetime: One foreground discovery batch; no cross-batch stale geometry cache.
municipal_cache.limits: Counts loader invocations, including missing data, using a local fixture. The old eager count follows its source loop; the new state-filtered loader count is asserted. No provider traffic, physical file-I/O count or battery measurement. Adds small metadata/lazy wrappers per town instead of loading every full polygon.

replay_break_index.comparison: Every break mask for sizes zero through nine and every prefix/backward position matches the frozen original implementation.
replay_break_index.limits: Break-scan work only. Retains one range per drawable segment; visible native GeoJSON still updates. Existing route sampling, exact coordinates, gaps and endpoints are unchanged.

weekly_reminders.evidence: Source comparison plus Android's documented same-IntentSender replacement semantics; no OS IPC profiler was used.

additional_scopes: Visit count repair and departure checks
Resolver logic after the cache class

limits: No measured physical-device battery percentage, whole-app speedup, provider allowance increase, DAU capacity or daily driving-hours gain. No GPS sampling, matching confidence, geometry precision, history retention, quota or version changes.
